Good to know

Your PupTempo
questions, answered.

Can my household share the same puppy log?

PupTempo keeps profiles on the same device. Household syncing is not included, so separate phones do not automatically share events.

Are potty estimates guaranteed?

No. Estimates use the trips you have logged and are routine aids. They cannot guarantee when a puppy will need to go and do not replace veterinary advice.

How do I get help with PupTempo?

Email info@digitalsprout.org with your device, app version and a description of the issue. You can also visit our support page.
